validate_skill_name: validate a skill name for lowercase alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores, and dots with max length
validate_skill_category: validate a skill category rejecting path traversal and absolute path patterns
validate_skill_frontmatter: validate SKILL.md YAML frontmatter requires name, description, closed delimiters, and body content
validate_file_path: validate a supporting file path blocks traversal, disallowed subdirectories, and root-level files
create_skill: create a new skill with validated name, content, and optional category subdirectory
edit_skill: edit an existing skill by replacing its full content with validation
patch_skill: patch a skill by replacing an exact string match with a new string
patch_skill_replace_all: patch a skill replacing all occurrences of a string with replace_all flag
delete_skill: delete a skill directory and clean up empty category subdirectory
write_skill_file: write a supporting file under an allowed subdirectory of a skill with symlink escape protection
remove_skill_file: remove a supporting file from a skill directory with symlink escape protection
skill_manage_dispatcher: dispatch create, edit, patch, and delete actions via a single skill_manage function
